It is made through the scales and materials by which the past becomes legible: from sweeping narratives and historical events to gestures, sounds, images, technical infrastructures, and seemingly minor traces SOPHIE PUBLIG is a Senior Scientist researching digital ecosystems. Based at the Weibel Institute for Digital Cultures at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, she navigates the intricate networks of online territories. TIMOTHEUS VERMEULEN is Professor of Media, Culture and Society at the University of Oslo and joint director of the Media Aesthetics Research Group. He was a visiting scholar in Art History at Harvard in 2023–24 and will serve as joint Principal Investigator on a project on the politics of tone at the Centre for Advanced Study in Oslo in 2027–28. CHRISTIAN HÖLLER is editor and co-publisher of springerin – Hefte für Gegenwartskunst. Since 2024 he is head of the department Cross Disciplinary Strategies at the University of Applied Arts Vienna. cro

candidateAudit.text: OUR PRE-GRAND OPENING ART EXHIBITION STARTS WITH OUR NEIGHBOUR! CONSTANTIN SIMON is a Vienna-based artist creating paintings and sculptures around the topic of what art is in the 21st century involving fundamental science and what our function as humans is (becoming). His former series "Astronimals" and the "Freud's Dreams" art installation at Burning Man 2022 explored the transcendence of technology, spirit and nature. His new series"From Singularity to Complexity" focuses not only on where we are going, but especially on where we are coming from and what unites us. Principles of this exhibition are universal, and singularity can be found in every complexity: Thailand-rooted Maison Naya and Viennese Constantin Simon, unconnected at first glance, are direct neighbours. (see the last slide where Constantin put post-it on our window in February 2026-we didn't know each other back then. Now we finally found him) At their intersection, a shared wall (literally), lies this exhibition space. Even the visitors bring their complexity to this single focal point in time before spreading out in all directions again. "From Singularity to Complexity" by Constantin Simon: -Monday-Saturday -09:00-18:00 - 4th September - 2nd October 2026 - S I R I | SPACE at MAISON NAYA - Free entry See you soon! #maisonnayavienna #art #artexhibition #vienna

candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: the universe knew we had to do motherhood together. 🥹🤍 Eine kleine Storytime zu diesem Reel, weil hinter diesen zwei Sequenzen eigentlich so viel mehr steckt. 🥹💕 Iva und ich kennen uns mittlerweile seit fast acht Jahren. Wir haben damals im selben Büro gearbeitet und uns eigentlich von Anfang an super verstanden. Aus Arbeitskolleginnen wurden irgendwann Freundinnen & sie war über die Jahre bei so vielen wichtigen Meilensteinen meines Lebens dabei. Bei meiner Verlobung, meiner Hochzeit, meiner Bachelorette Party … eigentlich in einem ganz anderen Kapitel meines Lebens. 🥹 Irgendwann haben wir beide das Büro verlassen, das Leben ging weiter, bei jeder ist unglaublich viel passiert und ohne dass jemals etwas zwischen uns vorgefallen wäre, haben wir uns ein bisschen aus den Augen verloren. Manchmal passiert das einfach. Man schreibt weniger, sieht sich seltener und plötzlich ist viel mehr Zeit vergangen, als man eigentlich gedacht hätte. Und dann hat uns das Leben irgendwie genau zum richtigen Zeitpunkt wieder zusammengebracht. 🤍 Wir kamen wieder in Kontakt & haben dabei realisiert, dass wir einfach BEIDE schwanger sind. 😂 Und ab diesem Moment hat es direkt wieder Klick gemacht. Wir haben angefangen, wieder viel mehr zu schreiben, uns regelmäßig zu treffen und irgendwie all die verlorene Zeit nachzuholen. Eine Freundin während der Schwangerschaft zu haben, die wirklich genau dasselbe durchmacht, ist einfach etwas ganz Besonderes. candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.title: Ich liebe personalisierte Dinge & gerade bei den ersten Baby-Essentials war mir wichtig, dass sie nicht nur praktisch sind, sondern auch schön aussehen und zeitlos sind. 🤍 Deshalb
candidateAudit.text: Ich liebe personalisierte Dinge & gerade bei den ersten Baby-Essentials war mir wichtig, dass sie nicht nur praktisch sind, sondern auch schön aussehen und zeitlos sind. 🤍 Deshalb habe ich mich für ein personalisiertes Set von korelicollection entschieden. Gemeinsam haben wir das Design ausgesucht, die Farben abgestimmt und die einzelnen Produkte ausgewählt. Für mich war von Anfang an klar, dass alles zu unserem Kinderwagen passen und mich auch in ein paar Jahren noch genauso begeistern soll. Am Ende habe ich mich für dieses wunderschöne Karomuster entschieden, weil ich Karodesigns einfach liebe. 🥹 Und dass jedes einzelne Teil mit Ayla Nils Namen personalisiert wurde, macht das Ganze für mich noch viel besonderer. <3 Mittlerweile sind genau das die Dinge, die ich immer griffbereit haben möchte, wenn wir das Haus verlassen: die Wickeltasche, die Wickelunterlage, der Beutel für alle Baby-Essentials, die Decke, die Schnullerkette und die Kinderwagenkette. Alles hat seinen festen Platz und ich muss vor einem Spaziergang nicht jedes Mal aufs Neue überlegen, ob ich etwas vergessen habe. Besonders praktisch finde ich, dass ich die Wickeltasche ganz einfach am Kinderwagen befestigen kann. So ist alles, was wir unterwegs brauchen, immer dabei und die Tasche steht jederzeit bereit 🥰💕 Ich freue mich schon auf all die kleinen Spaziergänge und Abenteuer, die wir mit diesem Set erleben werden. 🤍 Wie gefällt euch das Set? <3 #momdiary #babyessentials #personalizedsets #handmade #mommy

candidateAudit.title: Our first week wasn’t exactly how I had imagined it. 🤍 I spent hours being stitched up after birth, lost a lot of blood, and recovery was harder than I ever expected. Breastfeedin
candidateAudit.text: Our first week wasn’t exactly how I had imagined it. 🤍 I spent hours being stitched up after birth, lost a lot of blood, and recovery was harder than I ever expected. Breastfeeding didn’t come easily either. Every single drop of milk felt like a victory, and there were moments when I questioned myself more than I ever have. But in between the pain, the exhaustion, and the tears, there was so much love. 🥹 Watching you meet your dad, your grandparents, coming home together, holding you close, smelling your little head, and learning each other… those moments made everything else fade into the background 💞🧸 Our first week wasn’t perfect. It was messy, emotional, exhausting, even so it was unbelievably beautiful all at once. I’d relive every single second just to hold you again. 🤍 Welcome home Ayla Nil Firat <3 we love love love you!

candidateAudit.title: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not
candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl
